outcome: Maternal cesarean complications (hysterectomy, uterine atony, blood transfusion, surgical injury, arterial ligation, infection, wound complication, and ileus)
cohort: Nulliparous women with non-anomalous singleton gestations who underwent primary cesarean delivery
finding: In this cohort, the odds of cesarean-related maternal and neonatal morbidity were significantly higher for non-Hispanic Black and Hispanic women.
mod_finding: Non-Hispanic Black and Hispanic women experience higher odds of cesarean-related morbidity.
